cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: The Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

cards.name: Wyrdeer
cards.description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Kleavor
cards.description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
